name: Ballroom Dancing at The Waterfalls
reviewNotes:
Venue calendar names the organizer as "The Waterfalls Management" with music by DJ Valerie; no separate organization name is published. Email only appears in The Dance Calendar.

Directory research 2026-10-04: The dances are run in the clubhouse ballroom of The Waterfalls 55+ rental community, so the address is the community's (same place as the waterfalls-ballroom venue). Phone and email are the reservation contacts published for the dance (phone on the community's site; email and a second number, 631-487-3203, only in The Dance Calendar directory). The community's main office line (631) 738-6700 was not used. No logo recorded: the community's site logo is only 110 px and the touch icon 114 px (below the 120 px minimum). Photo 1 is the poster frame of the community's own 'Waterfalls - Ballroom Dancing' video (an older, slightly soft photo). A dedicated page also exists at https://waterfallsapartments.com/ballroom-dancing/. No Facebook/Instagram found for the dance.
description: Ballroom and Latin dances with DJ Valerie on the 2nd and 4th Saturday in the clubhouse ballroom at The Waterfalls.
